# agenco_tools_import (Resource)

Imports tools into an MCP source from an OpenAPI or GraphQL document and activates them. The import is re-run whenever the file contents change. Destroying the resource deletes the tools that were imported into the source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agenco_tools_import" "orders_api" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  source_id      = agenco_mcp_source.orders_api.id
  schema_file    = "${path.module}/schemas/orders-openapi.json"
  schema_type    = "openapi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application the tools are imported into.
- `schema_file` (String) Path to the OpenAPI or GraphQL document to import.
- `schema_type` (String) Format of the document. One of: [openapi graphql].
- `source_id` (String) Source the imported tools are attached to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic ID, formed as application_id/source_id.
- `schema_hash` (String) SHA-256 of the imported document, used to detect content changes.
- `tools_count` (Number) Number of tools written by the last import.
